legal.privacy.s5.p: Data is hosted on secure infrastructures protected by appropriate technical measures.
legal.privacy.s6.p: You have the right to access, rectify, and erase your data. Contact us for any request.

legal.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
legal.cookies.s1.p: Cookies are small text files saved on your device to remember preferences and optimize user experience.
legal.cookies.s2.p: Essential (session, security) — always enabled. Analytics — subject to prior consent.
legal.cookies.s3.p: Use the cookie banner on your first visit or the link in the footer to modify choices anytime. Rejecting optional cookies does not restrict access to public content.
legal.cookies.s4.p: Certain third parties place cookies governed by their respective privacy policies. Please refer to their notices.
legal.cookies.s5.p: Our cookie management aligns with applicable personal data protection regulations.
